asset_media_player_image_alt_check.name: asset_media_player_image_alt_check
asset_media_player_image_alt_check.value: "asset_media"."visibility" = 'GM_ONLY' or "asset_media"."is_image" = false or "asset_media"."alt_text" is not null

assets_scope_origin_campaign_check.name: assets_scope_origin_campaign_check
assets_scope_origin_campaign_check.value:
("assets"."scope" = 'SYSTEM' and "assets"."origin" = 'DEFAULT' and "assets"."campaign_id" is null)
        or ("assets"."scope" = 'CAMPAIGN' and "assets"."origin" = 'CUSTOM' and "assets"."campaign_id" is not null)

campaign_memberships_status_timestamps_c.name: campaign_memberships_status_timestamps_check
campaign_memberships_status_timestamps_c.value:
("campaign_memberships"."status" = 'PENDING' and "campaign_memberships"."joined_at" is null and "campaign_memberships"."revoked_at" is null and "campaign_memberships"."revoked_by" is null)
        or ("campaign_memberships"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "campaign_memberships"."joined_at" is not null and "campaign_memberships"."revoked_at" is null and "campaign_memberships"."revoked_by" is null)
        or ("campaign_memberships"."status" = 'REVOKED' and "campaign_memberships"."revoked_at" is not null and "campaign_memberships"."revoked_by" is not null)

features_campaign_code_active_unique_idx.name: features_campaign_code_active_unique_idx
features_campaign_code_active_unique_idx.where: "features"."deleted_at" is null and "features"."campaign_id" is not null

features_description_length_check.name: features_description_length_check
features_description_length_check.value: "features"."description" is null or char_length("features"."description") between 1 and 50000

features_graph_arrays_check.name: features_graph_arrays_check
features_graph_arrays_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("features"."sections") = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("features"."parameters") = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("features"."choices") = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("features"."resources") = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("features"."scaling_tracks") = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("features"."activations") = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("features"."effects") = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("features"."supersedes") = 'array'

media_files_scope_campaign_check.name: media_files_scope_campaign_check
media_files_scope_campaign_check.value:
("media_files"."scope" = 'SYSTEM' and "media_files"."campaign_id" is null)
        or ("media_files"."scope" = 'CAMPAIGN' and "media_files"."campaign_id" is not null)

media_files_dimensions_check.name: media_files_dimensions_check
media_files_dimensions_check.value: ("media_files"."width" is null or "media_files"."width" > 0) and ("media_files"."height" is null or "media_files"."height" > 0)

notes_gm_notes_length_check.name: notes_gm_notes_length_check
notes_gm_notes_length_check.value: "notes"."gm_notes" is null or char_length("notes"."gm_notes") between 1 and 20000

users_google_subject_active_unique_idx.name: users_google_subject_active_unique_idx
users_google_subject_active_unique_idx.where: "users"."google_subject" is not null and "users"."deleted_at" is null

users_discord_user_id_active_unique_idx.name: users_discord_user_id_active_unique_idx
users_discord_user_id_active_unique_idx.where: "users"."discord_user_id" is not null and "users"."deleted_at" is null
